name: publicWeb_setKennelFollowing
description: A web member's follow / home-kennel choice for one kennel — the app's kennel-card popup (Always show runs = 1, Never show runs = 2, Show runs within N km = 0, Set / Clear home kennel) — through the app's own hcapp_joinKennel in self mode. The wrapper resolves @publicKennelId, takes the hasher from the device row (always the caller), validates the values and passes only @isFollowing / @isHomeKennel; auth (token signed for 'hcapp_joinKennel') and every rule are the inner SP's. Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET. v2 2026-09-17: follow type 0/1/2 and home kennel.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Device-bound token signed for 'hcapp_joinKennel' (the inner SP validates it under its own name via HC6.ValidateAppAuth). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel (deleted = 0, removed = 0). No SQL default.

parameters.name: following
parameters.description: 0 within N km, 1 always show runs, 2 never show; NULL (default) = keep.

parameters.name: isHomeKennel
parameters.description: 1 set as home kennel, 0 clear; NULL (default) = keep. At least one of @following / @isHomeKennel is required.

rowsets.name: WrapperRefusal
rowsets.description: Wrapper refusal before the EXEC: kennel unknown/deleted/removed, no live device row, @following not in 0/1/2, @isHomeKennel not in 0/1, or both NULL → { success 0, errorCode 1230, errorType 12 }, logged to HC.ErrorLog.
Follows WrapperRefusal: errorTitle 'Kennel not found', errorUserMessage 'That kennel could not be found.'

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_joinKennel: Always the first rowset. success=1 after the write committed; success=0 on auth failure, missing kennelId (1250/12), not authorised (1337/3) or unhandled CATCH (1950/19).

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1250 missing kennelId, 1337 not authorised, 1950 unhandled; auth codes from ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 12 validation, 3 not authorised, 19 unhandled; auth types from ValidateAppAuth.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: From hcapp_joinKennel: Rowset 1 on error only (success=0): standard HC6 app error detail.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: 12 validation, 3 not authorised, 19 unhandled, or the ValidateAppAuth type.

rowsets.name: HkmState
rowsets.description: From hcapp_joinKennel: Rowset 1 on success only: the HasherKennelMap row immediately after the write (lines 320-328).

columns.name: isHomeKennel
columns.description: 1 if this kennel equals Hasher.HomeKennelId, else 0 — derived from the joined Hasher row, not from HasherKennelMap.IsHomeKennel.

rowsets.name: SyncData
rowsets.description: From hcapp_joinKennel: Rowsets 2+ are the pass-through output of hcapp_syncUserData (self) or hcapp_syncKennelAdminData (another user), executed after COMMIT and outside the TRY/CATCH (lines 351-376). Shapes are defined by those contracts. Self mode, so this is hcapp_syncUserData; the wrapper passes '2050-01-01' for kennels and HKM and 'ignore' for hashers, so these rowsets come back empty.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap when no row exists for (targetUserId, kennelId) — lines 238-253; KennelStanding is NOT set on this path

UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap — Following, IsMember, IsHomeKennel, AppAccessFlags, HcWebPermissionFlags, MismanagementRoles, KennelStanding (set/clear bits), KennelNotificationPreference, KennelEmailAlertPreference, MembershipExpirationDate, MemberSince, updatedAt — lines 257-291
UPDATE HC.Hasher SET HomeKennelId = @kennelId (isHomeKennel=1) or NULL (unfollow / isHomeKennel=0 when this was the home kennel)
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET IsHomeKennel=0 on the user's other kennels when isHomeKennel=1
UPDATE HC.Kennel SET KennelMismanagementTeam when @mismanagementRoles is set — rebuilt inline from HC.HasherKennelMap, HC.Hasher and DomainValues.MismanagementRoles (lines 299-314)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on missing kennelId, not authorised, and unhandled CATCH
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncUserData (self) or HC6.hcapp_syncKennelAdminData (another user) after COMMIT
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the wrapper refusal (1230).

On an error that escapes the inner SP the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_setKennelFollowing' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and returns { success 0, errorCode 1500, errorType 5 } alone (no detail rowset).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @publicKennelId (line 15-17) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
